title: Pan-Seared Barramundi with Juicy Broth
description: Cooking barramundi to perfection with a flavorful broth, perfect for a light meal. This dish showcases the delicate taste of the fish.
instructions: Season the barramundi fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the barramundi for 2-3 minutes on each side, until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 8-10 minutes, until the fish is cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, heat the broth in a separate saucepan over low heat.
Serve the barramundi with the hot broth spooned over the top.
